Figure 1 labels collided (Fermi/AMS share an anchor; Higgsino label vs thermal-mass line); two placement iterations.
The dSph threshold on m_A' at 3 TeV is not reached within the 0.05-100 GeV grid; reported as 'not below 100 GeV'.
